en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassa Bin Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Mahzam,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a Muslim slave, and for him is a Christian mother, and for the slave is a free son. It was said, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if the mother of the slave dies and leaves wealth?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be inherited by the son of her son, the free (grandson)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from abu Ayyub from Mehzam who has narrated the following:

“About the case of a slave who is a Muslim and has a Christian mother and a free son, it was asked what happens if the mother of the slave dies leaving a certain amount of assets, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘Her free grandson inherits it.’”
